_comment: Created 2026-09-01 with no in-game capture, so the description is TBD rather than guessed. Art pending. EA is inconsistent about the full name: the roadmap art says "Top Gun: Fighter Sweep" and both the 1.4.2.0 and 1.4.2.5 changelogs say "Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep". data/releases.json records that disagreement rather than choosing between them, and this page does the same - it leads with the short name players use, per the owner, and both prefixes reach it through the aliases. The Playlist row is sourced, not inferred: EA files every line about it under its REDSEC heading and names it after Gauntlet in the changelog text itself.
name: Fighter Sweep
_art_note: Art is the little badge the game prints beside GAME MODE on the Custom Search screen, not a scene, so it renders at icon size rather than filling the art column. Not captured yet; the tile stays pending rather than borrowing another mode's glyph. Custom Search covers core multiplayer only, so this mode may never appear on that screen at all - a REDSEC capture is the likelier source.
